resources.string: Speak normally. After about one second of silence, EchoSpeak plays your voice back and returns to listening. Cyan means listening, pink means recording, and green means playback.
Silero is the default. WebRTC is a lighter option; YAMNet also recognizes other sound categories. Changing the engine restarts listening and discards the unfinished recording. Your choice is saved.
DeepFilterNet reduces background noise automatically during playback. It may use the original audio while its model is loading. There are no manual noise settings.
Microphone audio is processed on this device and is not uploaded by this feature. Microphone access is needed to record and play your speech.
Allow microphone access to start automatic recording and playback.
Open system settings and enable the microphone permission.
